page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m4s.2xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual server powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, and includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation of approximately 0.1667 with 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is rated at a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark evaluations position this instance in the average tier for most compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core Geekbench score of 1489.0 and a multi-core score of 7000.0, while stress-ng multi-core CPU performance reaches 13123.11. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 786.13 GB/sec, though uncached large block writes drop to 36.07 GB/sec, reflecting a weaker Passmark memory score of 1621.48. For specialized workloads, the fractional GPU and CPU instruction sets support small-scale LLM inference, delivering 165.78 tokens/sec for text generation on a 135M model, though performance degrades significantly to 7.03 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the fractional GPU allocation allows users to access hardware-accelerated graphics and compute capabilities without paying for a full, dedicated GPU. This resource density makes it a viable option for lightweight GPU tasks, virtual workstations, and basic machine learning inference. However, the lack of local storage and the lower RAM-to-vCPU ratio represent clear tradeoffs, making it less suitable for memory-intensive databases or large-scale data processing. Recommended workloads include lightweight 3D rendering, virtual desktop infrastructure, static web serving, and small-model AI inference.
